title: Bipol: A Novel Multi-Axes Bias Evaluation Metric with Explainability for NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the two-step 'bipol' metric, which combines corpus-level classification (using models trained on the MAB dataset) with a sentence-level evaluation based on absolute differences in gender-sensitive term frequencies using specific lexica.
